question: At a fixed CORR25-derived realized correction-RMS profile, does request-conditioned spatial allocation improve preservation relative to uniform allocation on fresh sources?
population: 20 previously unused PIE-Bench sources; two per category; valid nonempty official edit and preserved regions; all 70 historical case IDs and image-content duplicates excluded

arms.REQ: New direct local CORR25 anchor: 0.25 P c, P=1-0.75 E; its realized 28-step RMS is the shared profile
arms.GLB: Global residual direction at own current state, normalized to the anchor RMS each step
arms.SFT: Request weights rolled by 32 pixels on both 64x64 axes; same histogram and anchor RMS
arms.PERM: 8x8 blocks of size 8x8 on the 64x64 weights, permuted by fixed SHA256 ordering R87-permute-v1:case; same permutation across seeds/steps; same histogram and anchor RMS

common_settings: FLUX.1-dev, 512 pixels, 28 steps, fixed memory and prompts; official masks used only for eligibility/evaluation, never inference

primary.unit: source; average the two seeds first

secondary.adjustment: Holm over these two prespecified positional contrasts

sensitivity: Report Holm across all three preservation contrasts and across all 18 contrasts (three controls x six metrics). Do not reinterpret the earlier R86 post-hoc family as preregistered.
confidence_intervals: 10000 paired source bootstrap draws, seed 87004, percentile pointwise 95% intervals
missingness: No source replacement or outcome-based removal; generation failures, metric missingness and complete-pair source counts reported. No unresolved label is silently scored as failure/success.
stopping: All 160 prelisted outputs; no significance-based early stop. Stop on systematic infrastructure errors; resume valid outputs unchanged.
interpretation: Fresh-source confirmation is conditional on this model, settings, benchmark eligibility, anchor profile and mask intervention. A negative retention contrast does not establish complete editing success or noninferiority in editing.
localization: Exploratory official-mask mean response inside minus outside; compare request, shifted and block-permuted maps
identity_control: Separate local Qwen v2 experiment, 40 R85 sources, edit-only; default 40 fresh reference plus 40 fresh source-as-output observations. Report false positives, unknowns, errors, and already-satisfied reference strata. No artifact validity or human agreement claim.
artifact_policy: Native PNGs retained on server for metric recomputation. Compact downloadable package includes previews, floating response maps, per-step RMS, source metadata, raw metric CSVs and statistics; no model weights or latents.
